Generating Service orders and Service Notifications

You can generate a service order or a service notification in the Service Processing (CS-SE) component that corresponds to a
reconnection order in an IS-U reconnection document (note however, that if notification is required, the system can only generate
service orders after you have set the agreed date and the notification work item is closed).

1 Note

You can also configure the system to automatically propose a maintenance planning plant for the service order. If there is an
order code, but no maintenance planning plant has been specified for the order, then the system automatically determines the
corresponding plant.

You can use all Service Processing (CS-SE ) functions in the service orders/service notifications, as well as print them, and
download them to another system. IS-U/CCS data is also available to you.

Service orders are generated using the same procedure described in the Work Management section.

Prerequisites

You can only generate a reconnection order if the disconnection document contains disconnection objects that have either already
been disconnected or are planned for disconnection. Prior to executing a reconnection, you do not have to enter a disconnection in

the system. This simplifies processing in cases where a quick reconnection is desirable after the disconnection reason has been
canceled.

Features

Reconnection orders are generated in the same manner as disconnection orders.

Activities
Reconnection orders are usually generated in a workflow step. You can also generate them directly using the Change
Disconnection Document transaction (from the SAP Easy Access menu, select |)UtilitiesIndustry > CustomerService » Process

Execution » Disconnection/Reconnection).

If you are working in an advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) environment, the system can generate the reconnection order
automatically during the dunning run. For more information, see Advanced Metering Infrastructure .

Use

After the reconnection has been carried out at the customer site, you enter the accompanying data in the system. You can also
confirm the corresponding reconnection order.
